prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. David McFadden at Dental Implant Center
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone, but **Dr. David McFadden at Dental Implant Center** is a strong Dallas option to investigate: he is described as a **board-certified prosthodontist** focused on implants, and the practice reports a large volume of patient reviews. [Practice website](https://www.dentalimplantcenter.com/)

For a second opinion, consider **Dr. Laura Rabe at Dallas Periodontics and Dental Implants**, a board-certified periodontist specializing in implant surgery. [Practice website](https://www.periodallas.com/)

Before choosing, ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what the full written cost includes, and what alternatives or risks apply to your case. A consultation—and, for a complex case, a second opinion—can help you compare plans rather than relying on ratings alone.
